verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity's Verification Flows let teams save a verification configuration and reuse it, including via a static link that verifies users without per-session code. That is a thin but first-party form of codeless configuration. The evidence never shows conditional steps, risk-based routing, country-specific requirement rules, or that editing a flow takes effect without an engineering deploy. Missing for 10: conditional/branching steps, risk-based routing, country-specific requirement configuration, explicit no-deploy template editing, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can configure verification logic without code — conditional steps, risk-based routing, country-specific requirements, and template changes that don't need an engineering deploy

citations.quote: Flows provide a way to save and reuse the same configuration across all of your integration interfaces.
You can use a flow’s static link to verify any number of your users.
